owner: Cross-Project Knowledge Sync Operators + PMO-3 Strategic Prioritization Officer
purpose: Map shared lessons into concrete project-specific actions so knowledge moves quickly across all projects, not only Parts Seller OS.
rule: Every lesson must become one canonical reusable_rule plus project-specific injection actions. No project may keep stale logic after a global rule is updated.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Learn EU seller market grammar and convert it into workflow decisions, not copied data.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Use EU seller learning fields in add_part, category, price, trust, delivery and listing readiness decisions.
injection_actions.proof_required: Workflow modules contain market-learning rules and test cases.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Keep task in OPS-022 until UI consumes the matrix.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Full marketplace waits until one-seller workflow proves reusable seller rules.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Roadmap must prioritize seller OS internal workflow before multi-seller marketplace features.
injection_actions.proof_required: Roadmap references EU Seller Learning Engine and one-seller proof gate.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Keep marketplace full build blocked.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Sell outcome and workflow ownership, not generic AI.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Lead messages must mention seller workflow pain: pricing, locations, listing readiness, stock memory and manual follow-up.
injection_actions.proof_required: At least 5 exact leads have seller-workflow pain hypothesis and offer alignment.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Do not send broad generic AI messages.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: First screen must explain buyer pain, workflow, trust and proof in 10 seconds.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Landing/demo pages must show concrete workflow cards instead of abstract AI slogans.
injection_actions.proof_required: Design matrix defines hero, trust, CTA and proof standards for every public/demo page.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Block generic AI landing copy.

injection_actions.target_project: Public Data Intelligence / Safe Browser Crawler
injection_actions.reusable_rule: No source_url + checked_at + confidence means no data-driven decision.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Crawler and manual research rows require source_url, checked_at, query_used, confidence, allowed_use and dedupe_key.
injection_actions.owner: CI-2 Pricing & Offer Analyst + Security Agent-C6
injection_actions.proof_required: Playbook contains required provenance fields and no mass scraping rule.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Block crawler build if provenance fields are missing.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Competitor rows cannot be used until price/CTA/source confidence is verified.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Competitor DB must mark seeded_needs_public_verification vs verified_public and expose next actions.
injection_actions.proof_required: All competitor rows have validation_status and source URL.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Do not use unverified competitor prices as offer anchors.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: No margin assumption without verified price/cost/confidence.
injection_actions.concrete_change: CFO checks must flag missing data confidence before using price signals for offers or parts pricing.
injection_actions.proof_required: CFO training matrix includes provenance-required margin rules.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Treat unknown price confidence as manual review.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Seed target is not a lead; exact company/contact/source required.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Lead rows must include exact company, source_url, contact channel, pain hypothesis, offer and next action.
injection_actions.proof_required: Revenue training matrix includes exact lead validation rules.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Do not count seed rows as revenue progress.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Warranty, return, tested and shipping states affect delivery promise and support risk.
injection_actions.concrete_change: 72h delivery scope must list known limits, warranty/return implications and support boundary.
injection_actions.proof_required: Delivery playbook/handoff template includes known limits and support boundary.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Block over-promising in paid pilot scope.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Done-for-you pilot must include QA, known limits, handoff and maintenance CTA.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Offer pack must sell one narrow 72h outcome with scope lock, not broad automation promises.
injection_actions.proof_required: Offer pack has narrow output, not-included list, price, delivery scope and maintenance CTA.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Do not sell custom scope without CFO/Judge.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Cockpit must show task, blockers, QA, revenue, CFO, delivery and learning sync status.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Cockpit should include learning_sync_count, queued_lessons, blocked_injections and next highest-value action.
injection_actions.proof_required: Cockpit displays learning sync metrics or has patch plan.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Keep local demo limitation visible.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Every creative product needs buyer pain, offer, proof, CTA and QA, not random content generation.
injection_actions.concrete_change: AI Ads Factory tiny demo must use brief -> hooks -> variants -> QA -> next-test recommendation.
injection_actions.proof_required: Tiny demo spec includes brief, variants, QA checklist, CFO cap and CTA.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Keep as research/tiny_demo only; no P0 build resources.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Content engine requires differentiated moat, production cost, monetization path and QA before active build.
injection_actions.concrete_change: YouTube Content Engine must stay parked until channel economics and content moat are validated.
injection_actions.proof_required: Spec has audience, moat, cost, cadence, monetization and risk gates.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: No production schedule until promotion gate passes.

injection_actions.target_project: Android Market Advisor / Investment Advisor App
injection_actions.reusable_rule: Financial guidance products need risk wording, no execution, data source plan and compliance guardrails.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Advisor app must remain internal watchlist/education tool unless compliance/risk wording is approved.
injection_actions.owner: CEO-D Opportunity Lab General Manager + Security Judge
injection_actions.proof_required: Spec states no broker execution, risk wording and source plan.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Block public financial-advice launch.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: More workers only help when they dedupe and attach to existing tasks with proof.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Learning tasks route 10k capacity into review, QA, research, dedupe, sync and unblock actions.
injection_actions.proof_required: Learning task manifest exists with one owner/output/proof per task.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Merge duplicate tasks immediately.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Optional projects can research/tiny-demo but cannot consume P0 capacity until gate passes.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Opportunity backlog must keep AI Ads, YouTube and Advisor app inside CEO-D resources unless promoted.
injection_actions.proof_required: Backlog has promotion requirements and capacity policy.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Park optional builds when P0 proof is weak.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Monitoring products need provenance, freshness, allowed use and confidence per signal.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Any data monitoring offer must include source registry, update cadence, confidence and CFO data cost approval.
injection_actions.owner: CI-1 Market Spy Chief + CFO / Pricing Controller
injection_actions.proof_required: Monitoring package has cost/risk rules and data-provider approval rule.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: No paid data spend without CFO approval.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Landing page must sell finished 72h outcome, not generic AI.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Website copy should show specific 72h workflow, deliverable, handoff, QA and maintenance CTA.
injection_actions.proof_required: Landing page hero and CTA are specific and proof-oriented.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Keep generic AI claims blocked.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: Local demo is not public proof; public URL/health/smoke/rollback required for public claims.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Every demo page needs deploy status, health check, smoke test and rollback note before public sales proof.
injection_actions.proof_required: Deploy SOP records public URLs or explicitly states local_only blocker.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Do not claim public demo proof until hosted URL exists.

injection_actions.reusable_rule: QA must block weak learning claims and unsynced project drift.
injection_actions.concrete_change: Bug board should open a bug when a project ignores global knowledge core, provenance, CFO or proof rules.
injection_actions.proof_required: QA board records cross-project learning/proof violations.
injection_actions.fallback_next_action: Judge blocks release/delivery when violations are high risk.
